title: Deep-link navigation logic duplicated between real arm and demo arm
evidence:
Some("application"), Some(aid) ->
          case demo_store.find_vacancy_id_for_application(store, aid) {
            Some(vid) ->
              modem.push(
                "/vacancies/" <> vid <> "/applications/" <> aid,
                None,

detail: demo_update re-implements the same entity match, vacancy lookup, and route-string construction that client.resolve_application_vacancy + the real arm perform. Two copies of the route contract can drift. Direct reuse is blocked (would be a circular import), but the resolver could move to a neutral module.
recommended_fix: Move resolve_application_vacancy into a shared helper module (e.g. helpers/) both arms import, so the deep-link decision and route string exist once.
